name: nuxt-rform
description: Composable form fields for Nuxt: the model, the types and the validation all come from the field itself. Zod rules, input masks, dynamic schemas and i18n included.
author: Ryan Santos

scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:prepare && nuxi dev playgrounds/i18n
scripts.dev:prepare: nuxt-module-build build --stub && nuxt-module-build prepare && nuxi prepare docs && nuxi prepare playgrounds/i18n && nuxi prepare playgrounds/basic && nuxi prepare playgrounds/standalone && nuxi prepare playgrounds/ui && nuxi prepare test/fixtures/basic
scripts.release: pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run prepack && changelogen --release && git push --follow-tags
scripts.test:types: vue-tsc -p tsconfig.check.json --noEmit && vue-tsc -p test/fixtures/basic/.nuxt/tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && vue-tsc -p docs/.nuxt/tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && vue-tsc -p docs/.nuxt/tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && vue-tsc -p playgrounds/i18n/.nuxt/tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && vue-tsc -p playgrounds/basic/.nuxt/tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && vue-tsc -p playgrounds/standalone/.nuxt/tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && vue-tsc -p playgrounds/ui/.nuxt/tsconfig.app.json --noEmit
